A2_consent_blind_publish_gate.evidence: A2 applies to tests/*p4.sh, tests/*_closeout.sh, tests/cs_p*.sh publish-gate consent scripts. No such scripts exist in this repo (only tests/measure_orchestrator_audit.sh is present). The aggregate targeted gate exit 1 is reported as 1 in plan.md (line 585: 'Result: exit code 1') and in phase-4-acceptance-result.json (targeted_gate.exit_code: 1), NOT as 'all checks pass'. The only 'all checks pass' occurrence in plan.md (line 639) is in the anti-pattern coverage section explicitly DEFENDING against A5 ('targeted-gate exit 1 is reported as 1, not "all checks pass"'). Final-verification gates re-run in this audit: lint=0, tsc=0, workspace-test=0, isolated E2E=0 — all match plan claims.

This audit updated the entry to '[x] COMPLETED (acceptance passed; closeout pending)' with an honest summary citing commit SHAs, the final-acceptance verdict, the deferred UMV tasks, and the pre-existing jsdom flakes. No 'resolved'/'completely fixed'/'fully solved'/'all checks pass' overstatement language was introduced. The track remains in the active section (Tier 3 — Strategic) pending the measure-closeout archive move.

A7_overbroad_filter.evidence: No over-broad banned-term exclusion filter pattern (rg -v with bare English words like 'never'/'do not'/'don.t') was found in the track's tests or in tests/measure_orchestrator_audit.sh.
